text:
cheng: heads up — caldera-mini v0.2 int8 bring-up shows a localized BLEU drop on zh->en and ko->en. failing cases often have mixed CJK + RTL punctuation (brackets, quotes). :frowning:

maya: can you paste a couple failing examples and the eval output?

cheng: sure, quick paste from nightly run:
```
# source (zh + hebrew snippet):
我想要这个【תודה】。
# baseline (fp16) translation:
I want this [thank you].
# int8 translation:
I want this ].thank you[.

# sacrebleu summary:
caldera-mini:fp16  zh-en  BLEU = 26.9
caldera-mini:int8  zh-en  BLEU = 22.3  (-4.6)
```

oliver: int8 shouldn't change tokenizer but we did land a tiny token-merging change in the detok step last week. could be related to detokenizer order. did you pin tokenizer?

maya: i double-checked the release notes — we modified a post-detok punctuation normalization to handle bidi markers. it was intended to be a no-op for CJK but maybe the ordering introduced a bracket flip when RLM/LRM are present.

eval-bot: nightly-eval/caldera-mini:int8 — zh-en BLEU 22.3 (-4.6), ko-en BLEU 20.1 (-3.9). full logs: https://internal.redwood/evals/5098761234

cheng: triage plan: 1) confirm tokenization parity (baseline vs int8) 2) rerun detok with bidi markers preserved 3) test with kvcache disabled in runtime (just in case prefix handling differs) 4) reproduce minimal failing sample locally and bisect detok patch.

tao: tagging historical context — we had a similar flip caused by U+200F (RLM) being stripped during normalization in #1729001234. might be related code. :eyes:

oliver: i ran tokenmap-diff on the three failing samples. output shows a one-token shift around the opening bracket when RLM present:
```
- ... 0x5B 0x200F 0x05E9 ...
+ ... 0x200F 0x5B 0x05E9 ...
# i.e. RLM repositioned relative to bracket between versions
```

maya: yep that explains mirrored bracket. detok later treats the bracket as closing due to RLM adjacency.

cheng: can someone run the minimal detok check? command i've been using:
```
python tools/detok_debug.py --input tests/locale/mix_cjk_rtl.txt --baseline ref/tokenizer_baseline.json --target builds/caldera-mini:int8/tokenizer.json --show-tokens
```

oliver: attached token lists (pasted):
- baseline tokens: ["我","想","要","这个","[","תודה","]","。"]
- int8 tokens:     ["我","想","要","这个","\u200F","[","תודה","]","。"]

sophie: ok, concrete next step: i'll pin detok + tokenizer to baseline in an int8 build and rerun the zh-en/ko-en evals. if BLEU recovers, it's a detok normalization ordering bug not model quantization. assigning to @sophie to run, cc @eng-runtime.

cheng: thanks. if you need a quick hotfix we can change detok to prefer keeping bracket adjacency to CJK codepoints when RLM/LRM is present. but let's reproduce first.

maya: adding regression test to locale-evals: sample with CJK+RLM+bracket should be added to the smoke suite so future detok changes fail fast.

eval-bot: queued rerun (pin-tokenizer baseline). expected runtime ~22m. i'll post results when done. :hourglass:

sophie: noted. i'll report back with the rerun and diff artifacts.

cheng: appreciate it — big oof if detok ordering silently regresses translations. we'll treat this as high priority for the release window.
